comparative_note: Autoencoder val MSE (0.2966) < VAE val MSE (0.3458) < LSTM-AE val MSE (0.7907) -- the plain feedforward autoencoder reconstructs most precisely of the three; the VAE trades some precision for its regularized latent space; the LSTM-AE reconstructs markedly less precisely and, per Phase 8 (v2) Section 2.11, its validation MSE actually rises after epoch ~50 -- a genuine overfitting signature on this feature set's short, sparse per-account sequences, reported honestly rather than smoothed over.
